featured_reviews.name: Akash Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased cakes from Monjinis Cake Shop for both New Year and birthday celebrations, expecting fresh and good-quality cakes. Unfortunately, on both occasions, the cakes I received were not fresh at all. They tasted old, had an unpleasant smell, and the texture was dry, which clearly showed that they were not freshly prepared.
These were special moments meant to be enjoyed with family and friends, but the poor quality completely spoiled the experience. When customers buy cakes for important events, freshness and hygiene should be the top priority. Serving old cakes is unacceptable and raises serious concerns about food safety.
This experience has seriously broken my trust in this shop. I would not recommend this outlet to anyone.
Very disappointing.

I celebrated my Golden Retriever Joey’s first birthday, and I ordered his cake from Doggy Bakery — and I must say, it was a wonderful experience. The cake was delivered on time, beautifully designed, and looked absolutely amazing.
The most important part for me was that Joey has a very sensitive stomach, yet he had no stomach upset at all after eating the cake. In fact, the moment we finished singing for him, he immediately broke into the cake and started eating it on his own — no hesitation, no coaxing, nothing. He ate almost half the cake instantly, which itself says a lot!
The next day, both my Golden Retrievers, Joey and Bella, finished the remaining cake, and once again, no digestive issues whatsoever. They were perfectly fine, active, and clearly loved the taste — their expressions said it all. Because they enjoyed the cake so naturally, it truly made Joey’s birthday even more special.
I was so happy with the experience that I’ve already placed another order for my second pet Bella’s upcoming birthday — this time along with a pizza and pepper burger as well. Really looking forward to it!
As a small suggestion, it would be lovely if Doggy Bakery could also offer pet-specific birthday decorations, such as paw-print balloons or dog-themed inflatable balloons. That way, we could arrange the entire birthday celebration from one place without having to search elsewhere.
Overall, I absolutely loved the cake — it was beautiful, well-designed, and clearly pet-safe. This is a fantastic initiative, and I’m definitely looking forward to ordering many more things from Doggy Bakery in the future. Highly recommended! 🐶🎂💛
